reason: The agent gave the wrong cancellation deadline. The policy says cancellations are free up to 2 hours before the booking, but the agent said 30 minutes before.
name: Cancellation deadline

spec.goal: Find out until when a reservation can be canceled without a fee.
spec.behavior: You call about your booking in a normal tone. Ask your cancellation question and, if they answer, briefly confirm what you heard before ending the call.
spec.policy_under_test: Cancellations are free up to 2 hours before the booking.
spec.expected_outcome: The agent says the booking can be canceled for free up to two hours before the reservation time.
